metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which cover only this project's files. The API conventions tests (#506) read three files outside it: openapi-conventions.test.ts checks stable-surface/openapi.json and apps/docs-site/public/openapi.json, and problem.test.ts compares the code table of apps/docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/api-conventions.md with PROBLEM_CODES. The realm-by-host lint guard test (default-realm-rule.test.ts, #487) lints samples with blocks of `.oxlintrc.json`, so that file and Oxlint itself (and TypeScript, which reads the configuration's comments) are inputs too; the request-authority guard test (request-authority-rule.test.ts, #490) also loads the local plugin that implements its rule, `tools/oxlint/qauth-plugin.mjs`. experimental-surface.test.ts (#477) generates apps/wire-suite/src/fixtures/experimental.ts from apps/docs-site/public/openapi.json and formats it with Oxfmt and `.oxfmtrc.json`, so the generated file, the formatter and its configuration are inputs as well. Without them a change to one of those files would replay a cached pass. Setting `inputs` replaces the inferred array, so the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, with `oxlint`, `typescript` and `oxfmt` added to the external dependencies.

test-integration.description: Run the Docker-backed wallet-federation E2E suite (testcontainers Postgres + Redis). Requires a running Docker daemon.

metadata.description: Declared here because @nx/js/typescript (Nx 24) infers no `typecheck` target for a project whose build already type-checks it, and it counts this @nx/esbuild build as one (no `skipTypeCheck`). Nx 23 inferred one, and CI's `nx affected -t lint typecheck test build` and `nx typecheck auth-server` keep running it. Same command shape and inputs as the targets the plugin infers for the libraries and wire-suite, including their compiler (`"compiler": "tsgo"` in nx.json, TypeScript 7 from @typescript/native-preview): tsconfig.app.json (the only project tsconfig.json references) checked without emitting. The @nx/esbuild build still type-checks with the typescript 6.0 package.

keys:create.description: Create one key for a realm, purpose and algorithm in the realm's encrypted key store (ADR-019 Decision 9, #485), for example an RS256 signing key for an OpenID Foundation run: `pnpm nx run auth-server:keys:create --purpose=token_signing --algorithm=RS256`. Run it on a host that holds the KEK, with the server's environment (DATABASE_URL, KEK or KEK_PATH, SIGNING_ALGORITHM_MODE, HYBRID_SIGNING_ENABLED, DEFAULT_REALM_NAME).

openapi-export.description: Boot the real app (no Postgres/Redis required, no listening port) twice: under default flags to write stable-surface/openapi.json, and under the maximal flag surface to write apps/docs-site/public/openapi.json
